title: E-government
duration: 3 credits (45 credit hours; 50 minutes per hour)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students grasp the basic concepts of e-government, understand its role, development stages, and types of services.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Compliance with regulations related to e-government
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand the basic regulations related to e-government in the context of international economic integration, especially in the context of the 4th Industrial Revolution.
Students recognize and use tools to implement e-government transactions between businesses and governments and between citizens and governments to solve practical problems.
Students have the ability to recognize online transactions for e-government.
Students can apply tools to perform e-government transactions proficiently.

Through individual assignments and group projects, students develop skills in writing reports, presenting, and delivering presentations on topics related to e-commerce and e-government in a scientific manner.

Students understand social responsibilities, ethical issues, and citizen rights, thereby taking personal responsibility in e-commerce activities. They also develop self-study skills and the ability to complete assigned tasks and assignments.
Students have awareness of organizational discipline, follow classroom rules, and have a cooperative spirit and personal responsibility towards class activities assigned by instructors.
